pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark patches with moderate edge angularity. Patches on the mid-flank are larger and more elongated, while those on the posterior region are smaller and more densely clustered. Pixel gradients at the patch boundaries are relatively sharp.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of thick, cream-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, and the pathway width is uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly towards the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder displays a consistent, high-frequency serrated silhouette with a low vertical amplitude against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent black, fibrous tuft (tail tip) is resting across the mid-dorsal flank area, creating a localized high-contrast textural anomaly against the patterned pelage.
